WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    'FY2025/26' as fiscal_year_comp,
    1 as fiscal_period_comp,
    period_start_date as p1_2025_start,
    period_end_date as p1_2025_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 1
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    'FY2026/27' as fiscal_year_comp,
    1 as fiscal_period_comp,
    period_start_date as p1_2025_start,
    period_end_date as p1_2025_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 1
)
SELECT * FROM period_dates

SELECT 
  business_date,
  store_id,
  net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25'
ORDER BY store_id, business_date
LIMIT 20

WITH p1_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    store_id,
    SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2025
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25'
  GROUP BY store_id
),
p1_2026 AS (
  SELECT 
    store_id,
    SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2026
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-31'
  GROUP BY store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT 
    p1_2025.store_id,
    p1_2025.sales_p1_2025,
    p1_2026.sales_p1_2026,
    CASE 
      WHEN p1_2025.sales_p1_2025 > 0 
      THEN ROUND(((p1_2026.sales_p1_2026 - p1_2025.sales_p1_2025) / p1_2025.sales_p1_2025 * 100), 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END as growth_pct
  FROM p1_2025
  INNER JOIN p1_2026 ON p1_2025.store_id = p1_2026.store_id
)
SELECT 
  SUM(sales_p1_2025) as total_sales_p1_2025,
  SUM(sales_p1_2026) as total_sales_p1_2026,
  ROUND(((SUM(sales_p1_2026) - SUM(sales_p1_2025)) / SUM(sales_p1_2025) * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct,
  COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM lfl_stores

-- Check if any stores opened or closed between the two periods
WITH store_versions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    store_id,
    store_name,
    open_date,
    close_date,
    valid_from,
    valid_to
  FROM dim_store
  WHERE store_id < 900 -- exclude web channel
),
p1_2025_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25'
),
p1_2026_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-31'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT p1_2025_stores.store_id) as stores_p1_2025,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p1_2026_stores.store_id) as stores_p1_2026,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p1_2025_stores.store_id = p1_2026_stores.store_id THEN p1_2025_stores.store_id END) as lfl_count
FROM p1_2025_stores
FULL OUTER JOIN p1_2026_stores ON p1_2025_stores.store_id = p1_2026_stores.store_id

WITH p1_2025_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rpt_daily_store_sales.store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25'
),
p1_2026_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rpt_daily_store_sales.store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-31'
),
missing_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p1_2025_stores.store_id
  FROM p1_2025_stores
  LEFT JOIN p1_2026_stores ON p1_2025_stores.store_id = p1_2026_stores.store_id
  WHERE p1_2026_stores.store_id IS NULL
)
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.open_date,
  s.close_date
FROM missing_stores m
JOIN dim_store s ON m.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE

-- Like-for-like growth for period 1: FY2025/26 vs FY2026/27
WITH p1_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    store_id,
    SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2025
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25'
  GROUP BY store_id
),
p1_2026 AS (
  SELECT 
    store_id,
    SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2026
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-31'
  GROUP BY store_id
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    'Period 1' as period_label,
    'FY2025/26' as comparison_year_prior,
    'FY2026/27' as comparison_year_current,
    p1_2025.sales_p1_2025 as sales_prior_year,
    p1_2026.sales_p1_2026 as sales_current_year,
    ROUND(((p1_2026.sales_p1_2026 - p1_2025.sales_p1_2025) / p1_2025.sales_p1_2025 * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct,
    COUNT(*) OVER() as lfl_store_count
  FROM p1_2025
  INNER JOIN p1_2026 ON p1_2025.store_id = p1_2026.store_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  period_label,
  comparison_year_prior,
  comparison_year_current,
  SUM(sales_prior_year) OVER() as sales_prior_year,
  SUM(sales_current_year) OVER() as sales_current_year,
  ROUND(((SUM(sales_current_year) OVER() - SUM(sales_prior_year) OVER()) / SUM(sales_prior_year) OVER() * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct,
  lfl_store_count
FROM lfl_sales
